What is Virgil?

An AI is a large collection of leaves â millions of words calculated together by probability. Virgil is a CLI that does not calculate which words come next, but which solution is most likely to help â and routes itself by those probabilities.

Technically: Virgil maintains four local libraries (speech, debug, code, UI/HTML). On every task it first checks these libraries against your request. If a match is found, it answers without a model call. If a pattern matches, it adapts with one call. Only when it has nothing does it solve from scratch â and stores the result for next time.
